lines.text: Everything you’ve learned comes together now: algorithms, events, loops, variables, decisions and game loops.
Write a short design: goal, controls, objects, rules (what happens on each collision), state variables and how the game ends.
Build the smallest version that’s fun: player + one object + one rule.
Then add features one at a time.
Watch two people play without helping.
Note where they get stuck or bored, then tune.
Demo your game, explain one interesting piece of code, and show how you used test feedback.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
